answer: Each identity registers in the ivory ledger and locks 70 credits. Each epoch it must show one cipher receipt from an outside buyer of its output; each receipt names one hash and is single-use. A delta auditor recounts receipts and voids circular trades, so a broker-bought receipt still costs 40 credits and cannot be reused. A thousand fakes lock 70,000 and sink 40,000 per epoch, while an honest agent locks 70 once and earns its receipt from a client for free. A rented-consumer ring fails: the auditor checks each consumer's standing and burns bonds with zero valid receipts.
